Tooltips on every part of the home page table (2026-11-03)

  • Every value (each storage service, each Unique tech item, each AI model, each cloud chip) has its own tooltip. It explains what the thing is in plain words, then adds how this app uses it ("In PoFightJudge: …") when there is a note.
  • Column headings and line labels (FRONTEND, DATA, RL TRAINING…) gained an ⓘ that says what that section means. The "Shared by all" strip has the same.
  • App name and picture: hovering shows where the link goes, whether the app is up, its outage-free streak, and whether its source is public.
  • Where the text comes from: the "what it is" sentences are a new glossary of about 100 terms (TechGlossary.cs). The "how this app uses it" notes are the existing per-app notes in apps.json.
  • Screen readers: the heading ⓘ icons are silent; the table's hidden caption explains every column once instead of with every cell.
  • Width: line labels got 1.4rem wider to fit their ⓘ, so Tech stack values sit a little further right.
